description:
Planning only — implementation requires parent overlap review. Target lib/zaq/agent/tools/web/browsing.ex (user baseline 95%, not remeasured). ONLY permitted implementation file: test/zaq/agent/tools/web/browsing_test.exs. No production changes. If test isolation is impossible without production changes, stop and request approval. Do not modify E2E specs, support files, configuration, docs, or unrelated tests.

Action reuse: not applicable — tests exercise the existing web_browsing Action and existing CreateDocument Action; no executable operation is added or changed. Existing implementation: Browsing.run/2 routes policy read via Engine event, screenshot folder listing via Channels event, and folder/upload via Jido.Exec.run(CreateDocument,...) which dispatches to Channels. Keep all real internal paths. Do not introduce another Action, mock CreateDocument, or expose another agent tool.

Test design and precise line mapping (all additions in the existing Zaq.Agent.Tools.Web.BrowsingTest):
1. Line 174 — In 'schema/0 and output_schema/0', parse %{command: "snapshot", timeout_ms: 1234} with Zoi.parse(Browsing.schema(), ...) and assert {:ok, %{command: "snapshot", timeout_ms: 1234}}. Then run Jido.Exec.run(Browsing, those params, %{node_router: Zaq.NodeRouterMock}) with echo_args_bin and a stub returning valid blank WebBrowsingConfig for :system_config_get_web_browsing_config; assert argv contains snapshot -i and the exact timeout was accepted. Existing zero/negative tests establish rejection. If just schema assertion sufficiently covers the line, omit redundant command execution, but explicitly establish validated positive input, not merely direct Browsing.run/2 (which bypasses schema).
2. Line 315 — Under 'run/2 error mapping', fake_bin script on 'get url' prints https://example.org/ and synchronously removes its own executable ($0); any other command exits unexpectedly. Use stub_screenshot_destination() (signed existing folder, no create request), call Browsing.run(%{command: "screenshot"}, context), assert exactly {:error, "Screenshot capture failed: agent-browser not installed"}. Assert no :data_source_create_file dispatch (stub flunks on other actions), and no newly owned PNG remains (compare temp glob before/after, rather than deleting anything shared). The get succeeds before the binary disappears, so Command.run/3 returns :enoent only on the screenshot invocation. Existing fake_bin on_exit cleanup is harmless after self-removal.
3. Line 379 — Do NOT invent a failing test solely for rescue. screenshot_page/1 receives only the binary output of Command.run/3; String.trim/URI.parse/URI.decode and slug sanitization accept malformed percent sequences as data. Ordinary non-web or malformed host inputs return the explicit error on line 376; for example https://example.org/%FF sanitizes rather than raising. A non-binary URL would raise but cannot be produced through the real Command.run/3 output contract and cannot be injected without changing production or mocking the module under test. Record defensive rescue as contract-inaccessible/unreachable through supported public execution. If a reproducible real CLI-output binary triggering rescue is later discovered, add a concrete public-path regression test, not a private-function hook.
4. Line 395 — Under 'run/2 validation', fake_bin returns 'https:relative' for get url; return nonzero if screenshot invoked. Valid scheme but URI.parse host nil enters valid_page_host?(_). Stub only Engine policy returning valid destination (provider disk, config_id 2, folder_path volume-a/Captures); flunk on folder listing/create. Assert {:error, "Screenshot requires a current HTTP(S) page"}, no screenshot invocation, no new temp file. Unlike https:///foo (empty string host), https:relative has nil host. This covers the fallback without private calls.
5. Line 443 — Fake get url https://example.org/; Mox.stub NodeRouter dispatch checks Engine event returns valid destination, and Channels :data_source_list_files returns %Event{response: {:error, :unavailable}} (or unexpected malformed response). Flunk on create. Assert exact {:error, "Screenshot destination folder could not be listed"}; capture script must not run; compare temp glob. This tests failure closed without duplicate folder or upload. Check event request provider/config_id/parent filter on listing, not internal invocation order.
6. Lines 456 AND 457 — Concurrent-writer recovery contract, deterministic sequential simulation instead of racing threads. Fake get url https://example.org/ and screenshot writes valid PNG signature plus DATA to its supplied temp path; script fails on unrelated commands. Supervise per-test Agent counter (start_supervised!) in Mox.stub NodeRouter: Engine returns WebBrowsingConfig google_drive/config_id 12/folder_id parent-17; first :data_source_list_files returns {:ok, %{records: []}}, :data_source_create_file with kind folder records exact parent/name, returns {:error, :already_exists}; second listing returns {:ok, %{records: [sealed %Record{id: "race-folder-42", kind: :folder, name: "example.org"}]}}; upload :data_source_create_file with kind file returns sealed canonical %Record{id: "saved-race-43", kind: :file}. Track list/create/upload observations with messages to test pid; flunk on extra requests. Call Jido.Exec.run(Browsing, %{command: "screenshot"}, %{node_router: Zaq.NodeRouterMock}); assert exact saved Record ID and success output, exactly TWO complete listings, exactly ONE folder create attempt, upload parent_id race-folder-42 and decoded PNG bytes, correct basename and no local path/content in response. Assert no extra messages/PNG left; Agent supervised cleanup, fake_bin on_exit cleanup. Add sibling rejection example: second listing returns an item with matching hostname but kind :file; assert 'Screenshot destination folder could not be created', no upload and no capture, to guard against accepting unrelated same-name items. Optionally second-list failure returns the same creation error; don't create redundant permutations unless behavior warrants.

Reuse existing fake_bin/echo_args_bin/stub_screenshot_destination, sealed Record/Provenance, Zaq.NodeRouterMock's per-test Mox.stub, DataCase SQL sandbox and on_exit env restoration. Existing module async: false because AGENT_BROWSER_BIN and other env vars are global. Do not switch to global Mox mode or add production test seams. Existing direct command return is synchronous and dispatch stub messages provide observable assertions; no sleeps, timing polling, network access, or actual browser. Scope file cleanup to per-test fake executable and action-owned PNG; never delete shared paths. If adding many overlapping stubs, extract only small local helpers preserving visible expected event payloads.

E2E: test-only regression of existing browser action; no new feature journey/spec or UX approval requirement for these tests. Existing real browser flow and zaq-xfj.11 remain separate; don't touch them. Parent must reconcile overlaps with zaq-5qu (generic browser coverage) and zaq-xfj.12 (config coverage) first.

Execution after approval, not in this planning task: run targeted mix test test/zaq/agent/tools/web/browsing_test.exs through Context Mode; run mix q through Context Mode (includes formatting) and re-run targeted tests if formatting changes. Review git diff --check and confirm only allowed test path changed. Do not run full suite or full coverage for this issue. At post-review coverage handoff only, designated coverage owner runs fresh mix coveralls.json (600000ms) then mix coverup, records unreachable line 379 as exception if still missed; final mix precommit through Context Mode (900000ms) after all work and required E2E, before asking final human approval. Never weaken existing assertions or treat an untested line as covered without a fresh report.

Independent root. Preserve line 379 supported-contract exception. Supplied-line mode overrides fresh full coverage instructions: no coveralls.json/coverup. 49 tests, 1 failure => 49 tests, 1 failure. All added scenarios pass except concurrent-folder recovery: the real Jido.Exec/Browsing/CreateDocument path dispatches the folder create twice (both return :already_exists), so the approved exact-one-create assertion fails. Two listing calls are observed; no test-only means to suppress duplicate dispatch without violating real-path/no-production-change constraints. Treat as blocked pending coordinator decision on whether to investigate existing dispatch retry behavior or revise the approved contract.  passes. Line 379 remains a supported-contract unreachable rescue exception; no fabricated test. Work remains in progress; no coverage run.

FOLLOW-UP BLOCKER (supersedes scenario 6 execution until human approval; no code edits): source audit of deps/jido_action/lib/jido_action/exec.ex:165-178,345-419 shows Jido.Exec.run/3 always enters retry engine. deps/jido_action/lib/jido_action/exec/retry.ex:136-161 defaults max_retries=1/backoff=250ms, no project config override found; Retry.should_retry?/4 delegates to Jido.Action.Error.retryable?/1. deps/jido_action/lib/jido_action/error.ex:483-484 treats string reasons retryable. lib/zaq/agent/tools/data_source_tool.ex:30-32 stringifies {:error, :already_exists} as Data source document creation failed: :already_exists; CreateDocument.run/2 at create_document.ex:42-64 passes it back. Browsing.create_screenshot_folder/3 at browsing.ex:448-460 invokes Jido.Exec.run(CreateDocument,...,context) without retry override and its comment promises never retry create; only after Jido returns does it relist ONCE. Therefore two identical :data_source_create_file dispatches before the second listing are Jido generic default retry of a non-transient collision, NOT necessary retry and NOT two Browsing create calls. Worker test diff browsing_test.exs:468-555 and test failure at :551 confirm exactly one extra folder-create observation; two error logs consistent with retry. The exact-one assertion protects non-idempotent folder creation and must NOT be weakened to two or hidden by malformed stub. Human approval needed for production change: pass max_retries: 0 as 4th option ONLY to folder creation Jido.Exec.run at browsing.ex:449, preserving validated action execution, upload/default retries at :504, original recovery relist, public error semantics. After authorization, worker/owner retains test with one create plus two listings, check before upload, canonical record and no extra creates; add a real-path regression for repeated :already_exists in existing test file and optionally fail-after-transient error to verify no duplicate creation. No test-only seam/global retry override; no production edits by this planner. Line 379 remains supported-contract inaccessible rescue exception. Coordinator serializes Mix; no Mix/coverage run in followup.

Production fix implemented with user approval: Browsing.create_screenshot_folder/3 now calls Jido.Exec.run(CreateDocument, ..., context, max_retries: 0) at browsing.ex:449 to honor the never-retry-create contract. Validated execution and one recovery listing remain unchanged; upload call retry behavior untouched. Action reuse decision: extend existing Browsing orchestration, reuse CreateDocument unchanged; no new operation/tool. git diff --check clean; no Mix/tests/formatting run per task scope.
